text:
## Escalation Matrix  
**Complaint Escalation by Severity & Involvement:**  
| Level | Authority | Timeline | Complaints |
|-------|-----------|----------|-----------|
| **Frontline** | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value |
| **Manager** | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss |
| **Director** | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, £500–£2,000 loss |
| **Escalated** | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, >£2,000 loss, reputational risk |  
**Escalation Triggers:**
- Complaint unresolved after manager review
- Financial compensation >£500 (Director) or >£2,000 (CEO)
- Regulatory or reputational concern
- Media/legal involvement
- Customer escalates to FCA

raw_entities.name: Complaints Escalation Policy
raw_entities.description: Establishes the formal governance framework for handling customer complaints at FirstUK Bank, defining severity-based escalation tiers, mandatory response timelines, financial loss thresholds, and triggers requiring board-level or regulatory intervention.

raw_entities.name: Frontline Complaint Resolution Timeline
raw_entities.description: Mandates that simple, low-value complaints handled at the frontline must be resolved within one day.
context: Frontline | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value

raw_entities.name: Manager-Level Complaint Review Threshold
raw_entities.description: Requires Complaints Managers to address moderate issues and financial loss claims up to £500 within five days.
context: Manager | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss

raw_entities.name: Director-Level Escalation for Significant Losses
raw_entities.description: Stipulates that the Head of Customer Service must handle significant issues and financial losses between £500 and £2,000 within eight days.
context: Director | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, £500–£2,000 loss

raw_entities.name: Board-Level Escalation for Major Failures
raw_entities.description: Mandates CEO or Board involvement for major operational failures, financial losses exceeding £2,000, or cases presenting reputational risk, with a resolution timeline of eight weeks or more.
context: Escalated | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, >£2,000 loss, reputational risk

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Escalation Triggers
raw_entities.description: Requires immediate escalation when a complaint remains unresolved after manager review, financial compensation exceeds £500 or £2,000 thresholds, regulatory or reputational concerns arise, media or legal involvement occurs, or the customer escalates to the FCA.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
raw_entities.description: External regulatory body whose direct involvement or escalation triggers mandatory board-level review and compliance obligations under the bank's complaints framework.

raw_entities.name: Reputational Risk
raw_entities.description: Identified as a critical risk factor that mandates escalation to the CEO/Board level, alongside major operational failures and high-value financial losses.

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Agent
raw_entities.description: Assigned frontline responsibility for initial handling and resolution of simple, low-value customer complaints within a one-day timeframe.
context: Frontline | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value

raw_entities.name: Complaints Manager
raw_entities.description: Responsible for reviewing moderate complaints and managing financial loss claims up to £500, with a mandated five-day resolution period.
context: Manager | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss

raw_entities.name: Head of Customer Service
raw_entities.description: Oversees significant complaint escalations and financial loss claims between £500 and £2,000, operating under an eight-day response mandate.
context: Director | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, £500–£2,000 loss

raw_entities.name: CEO/Board
raw_entities.description: Holds ultimate accountability for major operational failures, high-value financial losses exceeding £2,000, reputational risks, and regulatory escalations, with an extended resolution timeline.
context: Escalated | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, >£2,000 loss, reputational risk

raw_entities.name: Complaint Escalation Matrix
raw_entities.description: Operational safeguard that structures complaint handling through defined severity tiers, financial thresholds, and mandatory escalation triggers to ensure timely resolution and regulatory compliance.

raw_entities.name: Individual Customer
raw_entities.description: Subject of the complaints policy, with defined rights to escalation pathways and financial compensation thresholds up to £2,000 before board-level involvement is required.

properties.how_cited: Referenced as an external escalation trigger and supervisory body for complaint handling.

properties.risk_definition: Risk of damage to the bank's public standing arising from unresolved complaints or major failures.
properties.required_response: Immediate board-level escalation; dedicated 8+ week resolution timeline.

specific_obligations: Resolve simple, low-value complaints at the frontline
Review moderate issues and losses under £500
Address significant issues and losses between £500–£2,000
Manage major failures, losses >£2,000, and reputational risk

properties.applies_to: All customer complaints based on severity and financial loss
properties.evidence_required: Complaint logs, resolution timelines, escalation records

properties.rights_under_policy: Entitled to escalating levels of review based on complaint severity and financial loss
properties.risk_treatment: Treated as a potential source of reputational/regulatory risk if complaints escalate externally
